description:
VERSION NOTE: The first side only had 1 production in previous printings.
This is a card made accessible by the Cozy Pub, stage 3 of the Entrepreneur. The red arrows at the top of this card means that when you discover it, you must choose which of its 2 sides should be face up (the serial number must be at the top of this card, whichever side you choose). Choose wisely, since you cannot change this later.
